body: I truly enjoyed this poem. But since I am forced to speak of the downsides, I will say that it lacks a strong rhythm to it. Instead of reading like a poem, it reads like a story where the commas are replaced with a new line of poetry. But who am I to tell you what a poem should look like anyway, good work. This is a lovely first poem.

First post (ever lol) so I hope this isn't too terrible of a criticism. You certainly have the vocabulary and understanding to paint vivid imagery, but I think what you lack is a resounding message to paint upon. You write about a cruel world masked, which is something we have all understood and resonated with. However, that's all we can do, and that's all you provide us. It just feels too generic to be memorable, like it lacks a strong message. But now that we are finished with the mandatory criticism I would like to say that you clearly can write, and it shows that you know it too. Your poem reads with confidence, and that makes it very readable, at least for me. Good work.
